basic_info.description: Own a Rare Piece of Seacliff  Discover the unparalleled exclusivity of Seacliff, one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods. This rare gem on El Camino Del Mar offers breathtaking Golden Gate Bridge and Pacific Ocean views, a seamless blend of luxury and comfort, and a chance to become part of a storied legacy.    Step into this meticulously designed 3,200 sq. ft. home featuring 3+ bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, and awe-inspiring panoramas from every level. The top floor boasts an oversized ensuite with a walk-in closet, a cozy retreat with a fireplace, and a wine barperfect for relaxation or elegant entertaining.    The main level shines with a light-filled living room, an elegant dining room, a gourmet kitchen, and a newly remodeled ensuite bedroom. Downstairs, a versatile great room, additional bedroom, and lush backyard create a private oasis for gatherings or quiet moments.    Located steps from Baker Beach and the Presidio National Park, yet close to San Francisco's top dining and shopping, this home offers the perfect balance of tranquility and urban convenience.    Homes of this caliber in Seacliff are rare. Don't miss your chance to own this luxurious retreat. Schedule your private tour today and step into the dream lifestyle that awaits.
